scene: The heron unfolds wide, chiming loudly as three transit platforms clatter open.
picture: A side-scrolling view along the canal dock. On the left stands a yellow retro streetcar with folding steps lowered. In the centre, the grandfather holds his bicycle beside a red bento express train at a low platform. On the right, a glass garden tram dangles from an overhead cable.
shown: a vintage yellow streetcar waiting with open doors on the left track
a streamlined red bento express train puffing steam at the centre platform
a glass garden tram car hanging from a cable on the right
